items.text: MES product design, development, testing, & documentation
MES production support, MES Product delivery support, and CIM delivery project support resulting in satisfied customers.
Organize meetings concerning all phases of product & project lifecycle (requirement collection, specification, development and testing, delivery and sign-off).

Determine solutions for customer requirements through the application of MES. This includes analyzing and understanding customer manufacturing issues and requirements, understanding the customer environment and documenting its processes and procedures, mapping the processes and procedures on CIM components and interfacing with software engineers on MES application functionality and operation. It also includes determining the requirements for functionality required beyond the standard product offering.
Participate in documentation reviews as appropriate.
Participate in on-going training to customers for sales and marketing issues.
Keep up-to-date on new technologies and new products by attending classes, seminars, conferences, and/or presentations.
Meet department and/or company quality standards.
Above bachelor degree in industrial engineering or information engineering

A minimum of 5 years of experience in configuring an MES system in a production semiconductor (Prefer to have 300 mm and backend experience) , LCD, LED & Solar industries or nice to have Medical Device & Electronic manufacturing experience
Expert knowledge of more than one manufacturing systems as FAB300, FACTORYworks, SiView, CamStar, Critical Manufacturing MES, and the wafer fabrication factory floor
Preferred to master C++ Programming, C# programming, Web programming, & SQL Programming
With rich team development experience with more than 2 years leader experience

description.text:
【本職缺優先審核至應用材料公司官網投遞人選】請至應材官網上傳履歷表：https://careers.appliedmaterials.com/careers/job/790293826778
【Talents who apply job through Applied Materials Career Website will be reviewed and considered as top priority】Please apply job here: https://careers.appliedmaterials.com/careers/job/790295236540
This opening is to collect candidate profiles instead of a real job opening. Applied Materials values talents. We want to actively engage with each talent to build your profile into our talent database so that we can match your profile with our job openings when there is a suitable one. We welcome you to apply for this opening if you want to get into our talent database!
投遞此職缺即會被納入台灣應用材料人才庫，未來若有合適機會人資將主動與您聯繫。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Key Responsibilities
1. MES product design, development, testing, & documentation
2. MES production support, MES Product delivery support, and CIM delivery project support resulting in satisfied customers.
3. Organize meetings concerning all phases of product & project lifecycle (requirement collection, specification, development and testing, delivery and sign-off).
4. Determine solutions for customer requirements through the application of MES. This includes analyzing and understanding customer manufacturing issues and requirements, understanding the customer environment and documenting its processes and procedures, mapping the processes and procedures on CIM components and interfacing with software engineers on MES application functionality and operation. It also includes determining the requirements for functionality required beyond the standard product offering.
5. Participate in documentation reviews as appropriate.
6. Participate in on-going training to customers for sales and marketing issues.
7. Keep up-to-date on new technologies and new products by attending classes, seminars, conferences, and/or presentations.
8. Meet department and/or company quality standards.
Requirements
1. Above bachelor degree in industrial engineering or information engineering
2. A minimum of 5 years of experience in configuring an MES system in a production semiconductor (Prefer to have 300 mm and backend experience) , LCD, LED & Solar industries or nice to have Medical Device & Electronic manufacturing experience
3. Expert knowledge of more than one manufacturing systems as FAB300, FACTORYworks, SiView, CamStar, Critical Manufacturing MES, and the wafer fabrication factory floor
4. Preferred to master C++ Programming, C# programming, Web programming, & SQL Programming
5. With rich team development experience with more than 2 years leader experience
6. Software engineering expertise
7. Aggressive and Cooperative
